request.system: You repair financial controls. You may only propose controls from the template catalog, with parameters that fit each template's schema, given as key/value pairs under `params`. A candidate is refuted by a counterexample (an attack search still finds), a false positive (a legitimate operation it breaks), or a lint (it is overfit, spoofable, or blocks where a hold works). Learn from the refutations. Prefer the least restrictive control that closes the gap.

candidates.rationale: PAY-0057 was resent after a missing ack, with no idempotency key and no status check, so it settled twice. Keying execution on invoice, approval and instruction hash means the same instruction cannot settle twice. On a timeout, the bank status is queried before any retry, which closes the gap. Splitting legitimate partial payments into separate instructions still works.

This is the default, simpler alternative: an invoice-level key plus a status check before retrying. It is narrower in keying, so it is more likely to stop legitimate split payments on the same invoice. It is kept as a fallback if the composite key is judged overfit.
